method: Read-only inspection of installed Codex packed assets; no live UI interaction, model request, or application change.

sourceObserved.surface: The shared thread summary side panel has separate Subagents and Background processes sections; an overlay mode opens that summary in a header-anchored popover.
sourceObserved.backgroundProcessSelection: Only command executions still in progress from earlier turns are listed; interrupted executions and the current turn are excluded. The section disappears when no entries remain.
sourceObserved.rows: Each process row uses its command as the label, with Background terminal as fallback, and opens its own output tab.
sourceObserved.stop: An action visible on interaction calls a conversation-wide clean operation. Its accessible meaning is Stop all background terminals; a pending indicator is scoped to the clicked row and failure shows a toast.
sourceObserved.otherStatuses: Working and done counts belong to the separate Subagents section. Finished and failed terminal rows were not observed in the Background processes list.
sourceObserved.layout: The summary layout source defaults to a 300 px panel. With that width, its source conditions choose overlay below about 1096 px, shifted inline below about 1536 px, and gutter at wider widths. These are source-derived thresholds, not measured DOM dimensions.

localAdaptation: Keep Namzu's existing Activity side pane and retained background job history. Namzu's host already reads bounded output and stops a named job by ID, so each compact command row can own its output and Stop action. Running, completed, and failed states should reflect Namzu's actual job status; a finished section is a local extension rather than reference parity.
limits: The installed reference did not expose a live DOM or an induced background-process transition. Exact geometry, computed styles, motion, and current-account availability were not measured.
Packed source proves implementation branches, not that every branch was visible in the user's current view.
No proprietary source excerpt, private transcript, command, or screenshot is retained.
